headline: First red day in a fortnight: thin Saturday, cheap leads, $1,299 loss
commentary:
### The day
- We lost money: **−$1,299**, the worst of the last eight Saturdays.
  - NP: −$1,299 v $721 last Sat
  - Eight-Sat range: −$179 to $8,386
- Spend came down hard; **lead value came down harder**.
  - Cost: $21,870 v $37,375 last Sat
  - EPL: $12.75, under the eight-Sat low of $13.17
- The month's still fine: October running ahead of September on profit.
  - MTD NP: $158,372 v $141,489
  - MTD NM: 13.7% v 10.0%
### What drove it
- Search spend nearly halved and still managed to lose money.
  - Search cost: $20,976 v $36,615
  - Search NP: −$2,458 v −$1,414 last Sat
  - Search EPL: $18.78 v $26.24 last Sat
- Clicks, not clicking prices: CPC fell, volume fell further.
  - Clicks: 2,054 v 2,926 last Sat
  - CPC: $10.21 v $12.51
  - 16:00 abs-top: 7.9% v 12.5%
- uprova is leaning on the auction, up almost everywhere against us.
  - uprova account IS: 43.1% v 34.7%
  - Our IS: 10.1% v 11.0%
- Every tree paid less, so it isn't one bad buyer.
  - Direct (Inc ZP) EPL: $17.42 v $19.65 last 7
  - Test tree EPL: $16.16 v $18.95
- The free leads that rescued last Saturday didn't turn up.
  - No-source commission: $282 v $966
  - Remarketing leads: 88 v 136
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 31/10 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Off SAs onto ROAS | personal + competitor | $486 | $1,625 | — |
| speed walk-down | high target, stepping down | $606 | $1,217 | — |
| Scavenger pair | cheap clicks, weekends off | $1,060 | $1,303 | — |
- The scavengers are meant to be dark at weekends. They weren't.
  - Scavenger spend: $1,060 v $1,303 last Sat
- personal and competitor shrank with the rest of the account.
  - Combined spend: $486 v $1,625
watch: Search EPL over the next few days against the $27.68 month-to-date level — one soft Saturday at $18.78 is lumpiness, three in a row isn't.
uprova's impression share, up 8 points account-wide and 17 on payday_alternative, and whether our abs-top share stays near half of last Saturday's.
Weekend scavenger spend, which ran at $1,060 on a day the pair is supposed to be scheduled off.
